lines.speaker: Poppy
lines.text: Whoa! Whose footprint is bigger than my boot?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: Four round toes and one wide pad.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Let’s follow the clues—but quietly, and together.

lines.speaker: Poppy
lines.text: Will you help us count the tracks?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: Tracks, a broken twig, and soft brown fur. What animal could it be?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: Funny guesses—but look at the claw marks.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Something is behind those berry bushes.

lines.speaker: Benji
lines.text: Hi, explorers. I followed the sweet berry smell—and left clues all the way here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: When we see a wild animal, we stay calm, give it space, and tell a grown-up.

lines.speaker: Poppy
lines.text: Mystery solved! What do you think we’ll find next?
